# Psalm 139 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 139:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** To-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm. O-YHWH you-have-searched-me and-you-know.
- **LOGOS:** To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, you have searched me and known me!
- **PNEUMA:** For the choir director. A psalm of David. LORD, you have examined me and you know me inside and out.
